groups.problem: Background legacy-write goroutines derive their timeout context from the request context, so they get canceled when the request completes.
groups.rationale: All three point to the same parent-context inheritance in the async legacy writes and suggest detaching cancellation, for example with context.WithoutCancel.

groups.problem: The legacy DeleteCollection duration is recorded with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
groups.rationale: Same line (166) and the same wrong metric-function call.

groups.problem: Storage operation failures in Create and Update are recorded with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: The same copy-paste mistake appears in the Create and Update storage error paths, and both are fixed by switching to recordStorageDuration.

groups.problem: Legacy.Update receives the original objInfo instead of an updateWrapper holding the object committed to Storage.
groups.rationale: All three refer to line 139 and propose restoring the updateWrapper with the committed result.

groups.problem: The successful Delete metric passes name instead of options.Kind as the kind label.
groups.rationale: Same line 106 and the same wrong argument; they differ only in the consequences they emphasize.

groups.problem: The mode-3 success tests never wait for or verify the asynchronous legacy write.
groups.rationale: Both tests (Create and Update) have the same gap: the legacy mock expectation is never synchronized on or asserted. One testing approach fixes both.
